import sys
from collections import Counter

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n, m, k = map(int, input[:3])
alice_fish = list(map(int, input[3:3+n]))
bob_fish = list(map(int, input[3+n:]))

alice_count = Counter(alice_fish)
bob_count = Counter(bob_fish)

for species in range(1, k+1):
    if alice_count[species] > bob_count[species]:
        print("YES")
        break
else:
    print("NO")
